supervisor_summary: AT&T's research target (12m) is $22.99, the engine value of a driver set rebuilt from evidence on 2026-11-10 and corrected in the citation-gate fix (was $23.15 before the rebuild). The two biggest finds: the retiree health plan's prior-service credit, which props up adjusted EPS, mostly runs out in 2027 (10-K Note 14 balance; other income ~2,290 in 2026 -> ~1,189 in 2027 and ~551 after), and SpaceX's mobile entry now takes about 0.44M / 0.67M of AT&T's 2028-29 phone adds on top of the post-SpaceX 6.1x multiple Kilian kept. Revenue per phone is built from price actions (flat without one, a half-size back-book rise in 2028), Internet Air adds fade, home internet ARPU -2% in 2027, and AC EBITDA follows a 0.84 flow-through on service revenue from a Q4 2026 base of 11,696. The result sits moderately below management and consensus: 2028 adjusted EPS $2.78 vs the $2.82 floor, FCF $17.6B / $19.8B vs $19B+ / $21B+, consolidated EBITDA 3.0% under consensus in 2028 (50,995 vs 52,561). One card is open for Kilian (management's 20%+ home internet revenue pace, +7.8%), plus two smaller option sets (industry phone pool after 2026, home internet quarter shape).
